method: Native SVG lighting layer derived from current-minus-baseline designed surface gradients around Englassia; original raster textures and all existing native source vectors retained. No raw raster image edited.
light_direction_rule: Normal(-dx,1,-dz) under northwest light adds positive(dx+dz). Signed light=clamp(0.18*(delta_dx+delta_dz),-0.16,0.16); alpha quantized1/4096 to retain the small height change.
limits: The source radius and walking height changed in R60. This illustrative lighting is not a metric heightmap,canonical capital boundary or complete capital model. Existing neighbouring painted trees/ridges remain stylised; in-game fit and initial-era residents are not tested.
